lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 16 -- Home in Santana
lesson.grammar_point: demonstratives this / that / these / those + possessive 's (my daughter's bedroom)

listenings.text: Hi Mr. Coutinho, this is Karen, from Miami Homes. Good news about the apartment in Brickell. The owner's answer is yes! The apartment is free in January. You can see it again on Saturday, at eleven in the morning. Please bring your passport and your wife's passport. The parking is free, and the building is very quiet. Thank you, and have a nice day!

Hi, it's Paul. A small piece of advice about homes in Miami. Many families with children live in the suburbs, not in the center. The houses are bigger, and the schools are good. But the traffic is bad. Brickell is great for work. The bank is near, and you can go by subway. My advice: first, choose the school. Then, choose the neighborhood.

extra_audio.text: I live in an apartment in Santana. This is my living room, and that is the kitchen. This small bedroom is my daughter's bedroom. From the balcony, I see the park. It is a quiet neighborhood.
